description: IT4IT reference-architecture evidence tools — value-stream mapping checks and functional-component traceability for IT4IT value-stream work.

tools.name: it4it_check_value_stream
tools.description: Validate an IT4IT value-stream document: required structure, stage completeness against the IT4IT value-stream catalog, and traceability of each stage to at least one functional component. Returns a verdict with missing stages, untraced components, and stage-level details.

stream.description: The parsed value-stream document (YAML/JSON). Must include 'name' and 'stages'.

tools.name: it4it_check_component_trace
tools.description: Check an IT4IT functional-component document: every component has a stable ID, a value-stream (or 'shared') mapping, and no orphaned references to undefined stream IDs. Returns orphaned refs plus a per-stream component count.

known_streams.description: IDs of value streams defined in the project, for orphan detection. Optional — if omitted, orphan checks are skipped.
